framing_ar: نتيجة فحص وفق المعيار المذكور فقط، محسوبة من القوائم المالية المنشورة للشركة. ليست فتوى، وليست نصيحة دينية أو استثمارية.
framing_en: Screening result under the named standard only, computed from the company's published financials. This is not a fatwa, and not religious or investment advice.
method_note: Per-stock pages fetched for every ticker in our covered universe; Musaffa's methodology is AAOIFI with a trailing 36-month average market-value denominator.

rows.purification_note: Musaffa publishes no per-stock purification ratio on its public stock pages (checked at freeze time); its purification figures sit behind its calculator/account.
